question: Rearing of silk worms for the production of silk fibre is known as:
solution:
The correct answer is __**sericulture**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sericulture **is the **cultivation of silkworms **to **produce silk**. 
 
• **Sericulture **is **an industry **that is **characterized **by a **two-step process.**
 
 
• the **cultivation of mulberry trees.**
 
• the **rearing of silkworms **on **mulberry leaves **to **produce cocoons**.
 
 
 
• The **process of breeding, growing, management **of **silkworms **to **get pure raw silk is sericulture**.
 
• There **are numerous varieties of silkworms**.
 
 
• **Mulberry silkworms, airy silkworms, enormous silkworms**, etc. are a few examples.
 
• The term **"silkworm" **refers to the insect that makes silk.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Apiculture **is the **process of maintaining beehives **and **producing honey and beeswax**. 
 
• **Floriculture **is the **area of ornamental horticulture **that **deals with growing, marketing, and arranging flowers **and **ornamental plants**.
 
• **Horticulture **is the **practise of growing plants in **yards or **other outside spaces **for **ornamental, dietary, or medical purposes**. Growers of **flowers, fruits, nuts, vegetables, herbs, ornamental trees**, and **lawns are known as horticulturists.**
